about: My profile joins two things that rarely go together: applied AI research and shipping software to production. I design the system, build it and see it reach real users.

Since June 2024 I have shipped product across several teams at once. At J&P Periféricos I joined as an intern and now lead a team of 4; before that, at Codecta, I worked with a distributed team based in Chile, with code and pull requests in English.

notes.text: 1,000+ commits on ChatCRM, in production as internal software since 2025.
My own SDK published on npm: Tribu, SUNAT e-invoicing.
Co-author of 2 Q1 Frontiers papers (2026), on real Peruvian data.

letter: If you are looking for someone who designs the system and takes it to production —with research as backing, not decoration— write to me.
quote: Every number in a paper comes from a versioned pipeline; if it does not reproduce, it does not go in.
